globalGuardrails: No engine code before the Monte Carlo gate is green on the rule set it will load (tools/careerfit/mc_gate.py).

Inherit RLS and tenant context from services/api; no CareerFit table without a school scope.

DiscGraphChoice explicit, default graph 1 (legacy /careers/score's) and recorded; competency names joined NORMALISED (NFD, marks stripped, case-folded, punctuation collapsed), unknown recorded, missing ids → level 0 with a warning; LIA 0/100 → 1/99 with a warning, a missing subtest fails closed; personality poles from the stored counts (winner = 100·count/answered), intensity fallback, 0/0 → 50/50. tasks.notes: P1–P3 integration (branch careerfit/p1-p3) ships the orchestrator half: CareerFitEvaluator (read → adapt → rules → EvaluateOwner per scorable family → AssignRelativeFit → write), CareerFitInputReader (one RLS read session; fail-closed CareerFitInputException per missing instrument), CareerFitRunWriter (run + 14 family rows in one transaction, the student's tenant on the run), and the audit shipped with the scores as evaluate_owner's audit_inputs / convergence_detail / critical_gaps / mil_relative_strengths per family. EvaluateCore reproduces the reference at 0.0 deviation. 360 is NoData (careerfit360 0, NOT_DETERMINABLE, SOLID is the convergence ceiling). The per-formula-step ledger the acceptance names shipped on branch careerfit/audit: CareerFitAuditLedger adds careerfit_family_results.audit -> formula_steps, one record per F01–F23 APPLICATION the evaluation actually executed (F07/F08/F09 per contributing route factor, F10 per route, F11, F12/F13 per competency rule with a scored role, F14, F15, F16, F17 per MIL subtest, F18 per personality route, F19, F06, F20, F22 per convergence instrument, F23 only where F22 did not already answer STRONG, F21 once ranked), each naming the step, its inputs, its output and the governing rule or threshold with its provenance — 39–56 records per family, 709 for one run of the sample student. F01–F05 are the 360 AGGREGATION pipeline and execute only once FM-CF-007 lands. §21 itself is not among the vendored sources, so the granularity is read off sheet 13_FORMULAS_ENGINE's own subscripts and evaluate_owner's order of operations; if TIMS delivers §21 and it disagrees, CareerFitAuditLedger is the only thing that changes. NO new table: the ledger rides in the existing audit jsonb because every read of it is 'the whole derivation for this (run, family)' — the row being fetched anyway — while a table would cost ~700 tuples per run per student, forever, for queries nobody makes; so no policy, no GRANT, no fixture-schema and no apply-order change. EvaluateOwner is untouched and the parity fixture still regenerates byte-identical at 0.0 deviation. Still open for this slice: the endpoints (FM-CF-012).
